title: Repository id cache file
description: <store>/repos/<first 16 hex of SHA-256 of the common git dir>.json: one repository's id, computed once from its root commit and kept by its canonical common git directory in the engine's own store (the PiG adapter's <config>/observational-memory, the om command's root), never in the repository (docs/brain-memory.md, scenario 37). Source: memory/gitrepo/idcache.go (CachedID).
